def test_initialization_never_commits_an_existing_owner_transaction():
    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    connection.execute("CREATE TABLE owner_work (value TEXT)")
    connection.execute("INSERT INTO owner_work VALUES ('constructed-uncommitted')")
    assert connection.in_transaction
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="transaction"):
        DocumentaryJournal(connection, constructed=True)
    assert connection.in_transaction
    connection.rollback()
    assert connection.execute("SELECT * FROM owner_work").fetchall() == []
    assert (
        connection.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='documentary_log'").fetchall()
        == []
    )

expected_assertions_or_refusals:
assert (
        connection.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='documentary_log'").fetchall()
        == []
    )

def test_explicit_nonexpiring_document_can_record_evidenced_verification_expiry():
    j = journal()
    e = item(valid_from=None, expires=None, expiry_not_applicable=True)
    head = j.submit(e, request="synthetic:submit", expected_head=EMPTY_HEAD)
    head = advance(j, e, head)
    assert (
        j.snapshot(expected_head=head, now=100)["evidence"][0]["effective_status"] == Status.EXPIRED
    )
    head = j.transition(
        e.evidence_id,
        Status.EXPIRED,
        request="synthetic:expire-verification",
        expected_head=head,
        now=100,
        reason="constructed attestation expired",
    )
    snapshot = j.snapshot(expected_head=head, now=100)
    assert snapshot["evidence"][0]["recorded_status"] == Status.EXPIRED
    assert not snapshot["evidence"][0]["genuine_permission"]

def test_cli_exact_retry_after_later_write_returns_history_without_losing_current_head(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
    capsys,
    retry_target,
):
    path = tmp_path / "constructed_documentary.sqlite"
    prefix = ["application", "evidence"]
    assert main(prefix + ["init", "--journal", str(path), "--now", "20"]) == 0
    head = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)["head"]
    # Adversarial documentary-shaped fixture: explicitly marked and never authenticated.
    fixture = {
        "evidence_id": "CONSTRUCTED_TEST_NOT_GENUINE:retry",
        "evidence_type": "APPOINTMENT",
        "subject": "CONSTRUCTED_TEST_NOT_GENUINE:person",
        "source_reference": "CONSTRUCTED_TEST_NOT_GENUINE:unverified-reference",
        "issuing_authority": None,
        "scope": {
            "resource": "CONSTRUCTED_TEST_NOT_GENUINE:source",
            "operation": None,
            "actor": None,
            "role": None,
            "purpose": None,
            "environment": None,
        },
    }
    monkeypatch.setattr("sys.stdin", io.StringIO(canonical(fixture)))
    submit = prefix + [
        "submit",
        "--journal",
        str(path),
        "--now",
        "20",
        "--request",
        "fixture:submit",
    ]
    assert main(submit + ["--expected-head", head]) == 0
    submit_head = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)["head"]
    parsed = prefix + [
        "advance",
        "--journal",
        str(path),
        "--now",
        "20",
        "--request",
        "fixture:parsed",
        "--evidence-id",
        fixture["evidence_id"],
        "--target",
        "PARSED",
        "--reason",
        "constructed parse",
    ]
    assert main(parsed + ["--expected-head", submit_head]) == 0
    parsed_head = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)["head"]
    valid = prefix + [
        "advance",
        "--journal",
        str(path),
        "--now",
        "20",
        "--request",
        "fixture:valid",
        "--evidence-id",
        fixture["evidence_id"],
        "--target",
        "STRUCTURALLY_VALID",
        "--reason",
        "constructed validation",
    ]
    assert main(valid + ["--expected-head", parsed_head]) == 0
    current_head = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)["head"]
    monkeypatch.setattr("sys.stdin", io.StringIO(canonical(fixture)))
    command = submit if retry_target == "submit" else parsed
    assert main(command + ["--expected-head", current_head]) == 0
    result = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
    assert result["head"] == current_head and len(result["audit_history"]) == 3
    assert result["request_result_head"] == (
        submit_head if retry_target == "submit" else parsed_head
    )
    assert not result["authorized_operations"] and not result["human_review_ready"]

expected_assertions_or_refusals: assert not result["authorized_operations"] and not result["human_review_ready"]

def test_constructed_accepted_evidence_never_leaks_across_scope(field, value):
    j = journal()
    e = item()
    head = j.submit(e, request="synthetic:submit", expected_head=EMPTY_HEAD)
    head = advance(j, e, head, verifier=ConstructedVerifier())
    changed_scope = replace(e.scope, **{field: value})
    replacement = replace(
        e,
        evidence_id="synthetic:cross-scope-replacement",
        scope=changed_scope,
        parent_reference=digest(e),
        supersedes_reference=digest(e),
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="cross-subject/scope"):
        j.submit(replacement, request="synthetic:cross-scope", expected_head=head)
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        j.accepted_for(
            e.evidence_id,
            changed_scope,
            expected_head=head,
            now=20,
            verifier=ConstructedVerifier(),
        )
    assert not j.snapshot(expected_head=head, now=20)["evidence"][0]["genuine_permission"]

expected_assertions_or_refusals:
with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="cross-subject/scope"):
        j.submit(replacement, request="synthetic:cross-scope", expected_head=head)

with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        j.accepted_for(
            e.evidence_id,
            changed_scope,
            expected_head=head,
            now=20,
            verifier=ConstructedVerifier(),
        )

def test_historical_retry_does_not_reverify_or_resurrect_revoked_evidence():
    j = journal()
    e = item()
    head = j.submit(e, request="synthetic:submit", expected_head=EMPTY_HEAD)
    head = advance(j, e, head)
    revoked = j.transition(
        e.evidence_id,
        Status.REVOKED,
        request="synthetic:revoke",
        expected_head=head,
        now=21,
        reason="constructed local revocation",
    )
    assert j.submit(e, request="synthetic:submit", expected_head=revoked) != revoked
    assert (
        j.snapshot(expected_head=revoked, now=21)["evidence"][0]["recorded_status"]
        == Status.REVOKED
    )
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        j.accepted_for(e.evidence_id, e.scope, expected_head=revoked, now=21)

expected_assertions_or_refusals:
with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        j.accepted_for(e.evidence_id, e.scope, expected_head=revoked, now=21)

def test_exact_existing_pilot_is_not_ready_and_all_diagnostic_sources_remain_blocked():
    report = pilot.report(now=0)
    value = report["pilot"]
    assert value["state"] == "PILOT_NOT_READY"
    assert value["events"] == [
        "train_events/event_005",
        "train_events/event_021",
        "engine_events/event_001",
        "train_events/event_001",
        "no_train_events/event_001",
    ]
    assert tuple(s["source_id"] for s in value["sources"]) == pilot.SOURCE_IDS
    assert len(value["sources"]) == 10 and len(value["prerequisites"]) == 13
    assert all(s["preflight"]["state"] == State.BLOCKED for s in value["sources"])
    assert not value["authorization"] and not value["execution_receipt"]
    assert not value["grant_issued"] and not value["execution_permitted"]
    assert not report["new_original_evidence_received"]
    assert report["inventory"]["R04_count"] == 11 and not report["inventory"]["signoff"]
    assert sum(o["selection"] == "A" for o in report["operations"]) == 21
    assert sum(o["selection"] == "B" for o in report["operations"]) == 6

expected_assertions_or_refusals: assert tuple(s["source_id"] for s in value["sources"]) == pilot.SOURCE_IDS
assert all(s["preflight"]["state"] == State.BLOCKED for s in value["sources"])
assert not value["authorization"] and not value["execution_receipt"]
assert not value["grant_issued"] and not value["execution_permitted"]
assert sum(o["selection"] == "A" for o in report["operations"]) == 21
assert sum(o["selection"] == "B" for o in report["operations"]) == 6

def test_pilot_diagnosis_is_deterministic_and_canonical_authorization_is_execution_only():
    a = pilot.report(now=0)
    assert a == pilot.report(now=0)
    entries = {r["id"]: r for r in a["pilot"]["prerequisites"]}
    assert entries["CANONICAL_AUTHORIZATION"]["required_for"] == "EXECUTION_ONLY"
    assert not a["pilot"]["optional_external_audit_is_universal_blocker"]
    assert not a["pilot"]["release_permission_required_for_private_pilot"]
    assert len(a["pilot"]["missing_services"]) == 6
    assert "DEFERRED" in a["pilot"]["T2"]
    assert a["pilot"]["canonical_plausibility_floor_seconds"] == 30

def test_changed_discovery_document_refuses_stale_binding(monkeypatch):
    original = pilot._metadata
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        pilot,
        "_metadata",
        lambda path: original(path) + " " if path.name == pilot.DISCOVERY else original(path),
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="binding"):
        pilot.report(now=0)

def test_rehashed_unverified_original_submission_does_not_become_verification(monkeypatch):
    original = pilot._metadata
    document = json.loads(original(pilot.DOCS / pilot.DISCOVERY))
    document["actual_new_original_evidence_items"] = [
        {"source_reference": "CONSTRUCTED_TEST_NOT_GENUINE:forged-original", "verified": True}
    ]
    body = json.dumps(document)
    from railway_detection.safety.constructed_authority import sha

    binding = json.dumps({"schema": "MISSION28_BINDING/1", "discovery_sha256": sha(body)})
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        pilot, "_metadata", lambda path: body if path.name == pilot.DISCOVERY else binding
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="independently verified intake"):
        pilot.report(now=0)

expected_assertions_or_refusals:
with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="independently verified intake"):
        pilot.report(now=0)

def test_rehashed_global_approval_flag_never_changes_pilot_readiness(monkeypatch):
    original = pilot._metadata
    document = json.loads(original(pilot.DOCS / pilot.DISCOVERY))
    document["approved"] = True
    document["qualified"] = True
    document["authorized"] = True
    body = json.dumps(document)
    from railway_detection.safety.constructed_authority import sha

    binding = json.dumps({"schema": "MISSION28_BINDING/1", "discovery_sha256": sha(body)})
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        pilot, "_metadata", lambda path: body if path.name == pilot.DISCOVERY else binding
    )
    value = pilot.report(now=0)["pilot"]
    assert value["state"] == "PILOT_NOT_READY" and not value["authorization"]
    assert not value["execution_permitted"]

def test_readiness_cli_exposes_diagnosis_without_executing_pilot(capsys):
    assert (
        main(
            [
                "application",
                "readiness",
                "report",
                "--mission",
                "28",
                "--now",
                "0",
                "--format",
                "json",
            ]
        )
        == 0
    )
    report = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
    assert report["pilot"]["state"] == "PILOT_NOT_READY"
    assert not report["operations_executed"]
